title: WorkPulse performance.review_cancelled v1
description: A draft performance review was cancelled; cancellation is terminal. Identifiers and the state only — period, strengths and improvements are evaluative PII and never leave the database (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the review evaluates — the subject (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

status.description: Terminal review state; cancellation is allowed only from `draft`.
